Trade Ledger — Live

Live Albion market prices across six workshops — refining, crafting, flipping, Black Market, potions — plus profit alerts. Every price field stays editable.

About the data & math

Live prices come from the community-run albion-online-data.com API and reflect whatever players running its data client last reported — some cities/items update within minutes, others may be stale for hours, so check the "Updated" age on scan results before hauling. Refining profit = (batch × sell price) − (batch × (1 − return rate) × recipe material cost), minus sales tax; the material cost follows the in-game refining recipe for the selected tier (T2: 1x raw; T3/T4: 2x raw + 1x lower-tier refined; T5: 3x + 1x; T6: 4x + 1x; T7/T8: 5x + 1x — enchanted T4 chains use unenchanted T3 refined, and stone has no enchanted variants). Crafting and potion costs use the real in-game recipes, including artifacts, crests and silver fees. This leaves out station fees, transport, and specialization discounts, so treat it as a comparison between routes rather than an exact silver count.

If "Fetch live prices" fails right after opening this file directly (a file:// address), your browser may be blocking the request — try serving it from a local server instead (for example running python3 -m http.server in this file's folder and opening it at http://localhost:8000/).
